moves.name: Absofusion
moves.text: Kyurem absorbs life energy from the opponent with an icy blast. This heals 50% of damage dealt and lowers Speed by 2.

moves.name: Absolute Zero
moves.text: The user sends frigid, cold air to torment the opponent and freeze them in place. ALWAYS crits, can't be used 2x in a row.

moves.name: Accelerock
moves.text: The user smashes into the foe at high speed with its rocky body. This has +1 Priority, and can't miss.

moves.name: Acclimate
moves.text: The user changes it's type to become the type of the move at the top of it's moveset. +4 Priority.

moves.name: Accustom
moves.text: The user changes it's type to resist the type of the last Attack the opponent used. +4 Priority.

moves.name: Acid Armor
moves.text: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, raising its Defense stat by 3 stages.

moves.name: Acid Reflux
moves.text: The user covers the foes in stomach acid, lowering their Sp. Def by 2 stages and poisoning them.

moves.name: Acid Spray
moves.text: The user sprays highly corrosive acid all over the targets. This ALWAYS lowers their Sp. Def by 2 stages.

moves.name: Acrobatics
moves.text: The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user isn't holding an item, this attack doubles in power. Contact.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.text: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This has +1 priority, and can't miss. Contact.

moves.name: Aeroblast
moves.text: A fierce, loud vortex of air is shot at the target. ALWAYS results in a critical hit, can't be used 2x in a row.

moves.name: Agility
moves.text: The users relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This raises the user's Speed by 2. -1 Priority.

moves.name: Air Cutter
moves.text: The user slashes at the air, damaging the opponents with a blade of wind. This has a 25% flinch rate, and a +1 (12%) crit rate.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.text: The user attacks with a powerful blade of air. This flinches the target 30% of the time, and has a 50% (+2) crit rate.

moves.name: Alluring Voice
moves.text: The user lets out an angelic voice. If the target raised its stats that turn, this will put them to sleep for 2 turns.

moves.name: Amnesia
moves.text: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This raises the user's Sp. Def by 2.

moves.name: Ancient Force
moves.text: The user taps into a chaotic, ancient force. This attack changes type in accordance with a held Plate, and becomes 120 BP.

moves.name: Ancient Impact
moves.text: The user taps into its internal energy, dealing damage equal to user level. Boosts Sp. Atk/Acc by 3. +4 Priority, ALWAYS flinches.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.text: The user attacks with rocks imbued with a strange primal energy. This ALWAYS lowers the foe's offensive stats by 1.

moves.name: Aqua Cutter
moves.text: The user cuts at the target like a blade. This has a 50% (+2) crit rate. Contact.

moves.name: Aqua Jet
moves.text: The user quickly dashes at the target. This has +1 Priority, and can't miss. Contact.

moves.name: Aqua Step
moves.text: Quaquaval toys with the target, attacking using light, fluid dance steps. This ALWAYS boosts Speed by 1. Contact.

moves.name: Aqua Tail
moves.text: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a wave in a raging storm. This drops Defense 30% of the time. Contact.

moves.name: Arcane Fangs
moves.text: The user bites down hard with teeth infused with dragon energy. This heals 50% of damage dealt. Contact.

moves.name: Armor Cannon
moves.text: The user shoots its own armor outwards as blazing projectiles. This lowers the user's Defensive stats by 2 after use.

moves.name: Aromatic Mist
moves.text: The user releases a strong scent to entice the foes, lowering their guard. This drops Atk, Sp. Atk & Sp. Def by 2.

moves.name: Assurance
moves.text: If the target has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack's power is doubled. Contact.

moves.name: Astral Storm
moves.text: The user releases an intense blast fueled by spiritual energy. This ALWAYS results in a critical hit. Can't be used 2x in a row.

moves.name: Aura Sphere
moves.text: The user lets loose a blast of aura power from deep within itself. This has a 25% chance to drop Sp. Def by 1, and can't miss.

moves.name: Aura Wheel
moves.text: Morpeko charges at the target. This ALWAYS boosts their Speed by 1, and changes types based on their current form. Contact.

moves.name: Aurora Beam
moves.text: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This ALWAYS drops BOTH of the foe's offensive stats by 1.

moves.name: Aurora Veil
moves.text: A wondrous wall of light is put up to halve damage from all Attacks for 5 turns. Only works when snowing.

moves.name: Avalanche
moves.text: The user summons a devastating avalanche. -4 priority, 100% flinch. If the user is hit before using this, it doubles in power.

moves.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
moves.text: The user looks at the foe cutely, making them hesitant. This has +4 Priority, and drops Attack by 1.

moves.name: Baneful Bunker
moves.text: The user shields from attacks with its poisonous or venomous body, poisoning any foe who makes contact.

moves.name: Barb Barrage
moves.text: The user unleashes a barrage of poisonous barbs. This ALWAYS poisons, and doubles in power if the target is already poisoned.

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.text: The user passes on any stat boosts it has to a party member. This ALWAYS goes last. (-6 Priority)

moves.name: Battle Cry
moves.text: Letting out a battle cry, the user intimidates the foes, lowering their Attack and Sp. Atk stats by 2 stages.

moves.name: Beak Blast
moves.text: Toucannon launches a blast from their beak. Burns those who make contact, AND the target. Can't be used 2x in a row.

moves.name: Beat Up
moves.text: Ganging up on the foe, this uses the user's Attack stat, but the BP of each hit is calculated with: (Party Member Base Attack/10) +5.

moves.name: Befriend
moves.text: The user befriends the target, making them less hostile. This lowers the target's Sp. Atk by 2.

moves.name: Befuddle
moves.text: The user acts cute, then attacks the moment their guard falls. This has +1 priority, can't miss. Contact.

moves.name: Belch
moves.text: Only after eating a berry, the user belches, ALWAYS boosting Sp. Atk by 1 after use. You can switch & keep using it. 30% flinch rate.

moves.name: Belly Drum
moves.text: The user vigorously bangs on its chest or belly. This gives +6 Attack in exchange for 50% of their max HP. -1 Priority.

moves.name: Bind
moves.text: The target is squeezed for 3-5 turns, preventing switching & dealing 12% of the foe's max HP per turn. Contact.

moves.name: Bitter Blade
moves.text: Ceruledge focuses its bitterness into a powerful slash. This heals 50% of damage dealt, and ALWAYS crits. Contact.

moves.name: Bitter Blaze
moves.text: The user focuses its bitterness into a powerful flame. This heals 50% of damage dealt, and ALWAYS crits.

moves.name: Bitter Malice
moves.text: The user attacks with spine-chilling resentment. This ALWAYS lowers both offensive stats by 1.

moves.name: Blast Burn
moves.text: The target is razed by an intense fiery blast. This drops the user's Sp. Atk by 2 after use, however.

moves.name: Blaze Kick
moves.text: The user launches a blazing kick into the target. This burns the target 20% of the time. Contact.

moves.name: Blazing Assault
moves.text: The user, cloaked in flames, charges with all of the power it can muster. This drops the user's Attack by 2 after use.

moves.name: Bleakwind Storm
moves.text: The user summons a powerful storm of chilling air. This ALWAYS flinches, and drops offensive stats by -1. +4 Priority.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.text: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opponents. This has a 10% chance to freeze the foe. No missing in snow.

moves.name: Block
moves.text: The user blocks the foe from being able to switch out.

moves.name: Body Press
moves.text: The user slams its body into the target. Contact. This uses the user's Defense stat instead of the Attack stat.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.text: The user slams its body onto the foe. This has a 30% chance to paralyze the foe. Contact.

moves.name: Bone Rush
moves.text: The user sends a rapid flurry of bones at the foe. This hits 2-5 times, and has +1 Priority.

moves.name: Boomburst
moves.text: The user unleashes a devastatingly loud soundwave.

moves.name: Boulder Bash
moves.text: The user punches the foe with rock-shattering strength. This ALWAYS drops the foe's Defense stat by 1. Contact.

moves.name: Bounce
moves.text: The use jumps up high, and strikes the target on the 2nd turn. 50% chance to paralyze the foe. Contact.

moves.name: Branch Leech
moves.text: The user stabs the foe with a branch and drains their health. This heals ALL of the damage dealt. Contact.

moves.name: Brave Bird
moves.text: The user tucks its body in and charges from a low altitude. This has 33% recoil, and a 30% chance to flinch. Contact.

moves.name: Breaking Swipe
moves.text: The user makes a disruptive swipe at the targets. This ALWAYS drops BOTH of the foe's offensive stats by 1. Contact.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.text: The user chops hard with any limb it can use. This breaks any screens, & has a 30% chance to drop Defense. Contact.

moves.name: Brine
moves.text: The user douses the target with extremely salty water. If the target's HP is 50% or below, this attack will double in power.

moves.name: Brutal Bash
moves.text: The user crashes into the foe with great force. Contact. This ALWAYS lands a critical hit. Can't be used 2x in a row.

moves.name: Brutal Blade
moves.text: The user slashes at the target with great force. ALWAYS results in a critical hit. Can't be used 2x in a row. Contact.

moves.name: Brutal Swing
moves.text: Wildly swinging around, the user crashes into the foe. This deals 33% recoil, and ignores any stat boosts the foe has. Contact.

moves.name: Bubble Beam
moves.text: The user shoots a pressurized beam of water that covers the target in bubbles, ALWAYS lowering their Speed by 2.

moves.name: Bubble Burst
moves.text: The user releases a flurry of exploding bubbles down on the foe. This ALWAYS lowers Speed by 1.

moves.name: Bug Biting
moves.text: The user nibbles at the foe. This hits twice, & if the foe has a berry, the user steals the effect. 15% flinch rate per hit. Contact.

moves.name: Bug Bomber
moves.text: The user fires 3 balls made of varying components at the foe. This hits 3 times, ALWAYS crits, but can't be used 2x in a row.

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.text: The user generates a devastating sound wave with vibration. This flinches the foes 30% of the time.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.text: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body. This raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.text: The user paves over the terrain with force, ALWAYS lowering the Speed of all but the user by 2.

moves.name: Bullet Punch
moves.text: The user strikes the target with a punch as fast & hard as a bullet. This has +1 Priority, and can't miss. Contact.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.text: Hard seeds are forcefully shot at the target in rapid succession. This hit 2-5 times in a row.

moves.name: Burn Up
moves.text: The user unleashes a fiery blast. This removes your Fire typing until switched out. Fails if not Fire-type. ALWAYS burns.

moves.name: Burning Bulwark
moves.text: The user shields itself from attacks with a burning-hot barrier. This ALWAYS burns those who make contact.

moves.name: Burning Jealousy
moves.text: The user attacks with energy fueled by its jealousy. Doubles in power if the foe boosted stats this turn.

moves.name: Bursting Flames
moves.text: The user fires 3 bursts of flames at the opponent. This hits 3 times and burns up any gems or berries the target holds.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.text: The user focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise it's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats by 1.

moves.name: Caustic Acid
moves.text: The user sprays extremely corrosive, burning acid at the foe. This ALWAYS burns the target.

moves.name: Ceaseless Edge
moves.text: The user slashes violently with a sharp blade, leaving behind pieces. ALWAYS crits, and sets up a layer of spikes. Contact.

moves.name: Celebrate
moves.text: Delibird summons a massive present with holiday spirit. This gives Delibird +1 to ALL stats. -1 Priority.

moves.name: Charge Beam
moves.text: The user fires off a beam of electricity to attack while charging energy. This ALWAYS raises the user's Sp. Atk by 1 after use.

moves.name: Charm
moves.text: The user charms the target, making them less hostile. This lowers the target's Attack by 2.

moves.name: Chilling Water
moves.text: The user showers the target with water so cold it saps their power. This ALWAYS drops BOTH of the foe's offensive stats by 1.

moves.name: Chilly Reception
moves.text: Slowking tells a chillingly bad joke. This summons a snowstorm, and Slowking hides, swapping places with another teammate.

moves.name: Chloroblast
moves.text: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll in a powerful blast. Costs 50% of your max HP, but boosts Sp. Atk after. ALWAYS crits.

moves.name: Circle Throw
moves.text: The target is thrown out of battle, forced to swap out. This attack always goes last, and can't miss. Contact. -6 Prio.

moves.name: Clangorous Soul
moves.text: Kommo-o does an energetic dance, boosting all stats. This tires them out, losing 30% HP & making them drowsy, sleeping in 3 turns. -1 Prio.

moves.name: Clear Smog
moves.text: The user emits an odd gas which damages those hit and also removes all stat changes of those hit.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.text: The user aggresively attacks the foe up close, without guarding itself. This lowers the user's Defensive stats by 1 after. Contact.

moves.name: Coil
moves.text: The user coils up it's long body. This boosts the user's Attack, Defense and Accuracy by 1.

moves.name: Collision Course
moves.text: The user crashes into the target while spinning with great force. Deals 30% more if SE. 50% recoil. -1 Defenses. +1 Speed. Contact.

moves.name: Comeuppance
moves.text: The user moves last, dealing 1.5x damage taken back to the target with a vengeful attack. -5 Prio.

moves.name: Confide
moves.text: The user tells the target a shocking secret, which lowers their Sp. Def and Sp. Atk by 1. Bypasses Protect.

moves.name: Copycat
moves.text: The user performs the most recently used move by any Pokemon. +6 Priority.

moves.name: Cosmic Power
moves.text: The user absorbs mystic energy from space to raise it's Sp. Atk, Defense and Sp. Def stats by 1.

moves.name: Cotton Guard
moves.text: The user produces and wraps itself in dense cotton. This raises the user's Defense stat by 3.

moves.name: Cotton Spore
moves.text: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to the foes, lowering Speed, Sp. Atk & Atk by 2.

moves.name: Counter
moves.text: The user moves last, dealing 2x damage taken from any Physical Attack back to the target. -5 Prio.

moves.name: Court Change
moves.text: The user swaps field conditions from one side of the battle to another. (Hazards, Screens, Tailwind, etc) +6 Priority.

moves.name: Crabhammer
moves.text: The user slams the foe with their claw, catching them off guard. This ALWAYS crits, ALWAYS flinches, and has +4 Priority. Contact.

moves.name: Creeping Strike
moves.text: The user creeps up on the foe, striking when they least expect. This has +1 Priority, and can't miss. Contact.

moves.name: Cross Chop
moves.text: The user delivers a powerful chop with two hands, blades, or the like. This has a 50% (+2) critical hit rate. Contact.

moves.name: Cross Poison
moves.text: The user slashes with poisonous blades, claws or the like. This has a 50% (+2) crit rate and poisons 20% of the time. Contact.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.text: The user bites down hard and violently onto the foe. This has a 30% chance to drop their Defense by 1. Contact.

moves.name: Crush Grip
moves.text: Regigigas grips the foe with primal force. Stronger if foe is healthy, maxing at 120 BP. Absorbs 50% damage. Contact.

moves.name: Cryo-Overload
moves.text: Minun gathers energy for a turn, then releases an icy blast fueled with a strange electric charge. ALWAYS paralyyzes, heals ALL damage dealt.

moves.name: Curse
moves.text: The user lays down 50% of its max HP to put a curse on the target. This deals 25% HP per turn to those afflicted.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.text: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark energy. This flinches 30% of the time, & inflicts a nightmare on a sleeping foe.

moves.name: Dark Void
moves.text: Darkrai traps the foes in a world of darkness, putting them to sleep for 3 turns.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.text: The user damages the foes by emiting a beautiful gleam of light energy. This has a 25% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk stat by 1.

moves.name: Decorate
moves.text: Alcremie decorates itself, boosting Defense, Sp. Def and Sp. Atk by 2. -1 Priority.

moves.name: Defend Order
moves.text: Vespiquen orders its underlings to shield its body. This raises its Defensive stats by 1. This has +4 Priority.

moves.name: Defense Curl
moves.text: The user braces itself, boosting Defense by 1 after use.

moves.name: Deflate
moves.text: The user releases built up internal pressure, healing to full HP. This has +4 Priority.

moves.name: Defog
moves.text: The user blows away entry hazards, screens and more. This lowers evasiveness of the target by 1.

moves.name: Destiny Bond
moves.text: A Pokemon that knocks out the user also faints if this move was used. Less likely to succeed if used in succession.

moves.name: Detonate
moves.text: The user blows itself up in a fiery explosion, fainting themselves. This ALWAYS burns, and ALWAYS crits.

moves.name: Devious Lick
moves.text: The user licks the foe with its filthy tongue. This curses the foe, losing 25% HP at the end of each turn.

moves.name: Diamond Storm
moves.text: Using its own gemstones, the user summons a massive storm of diamonds. This deals 50% recoil AND drops Defenses by 1.

moves.name: Dig
moves.text: The user burrows, then attacks on the next turn. This boosts Accuracy by 1 after use, & bypasses protect. Contact.

moves.name: Dire Claw
moves.text: The user slashes intensely with ruinous claws. This ALWAYS crits, and has a 75% to poison, paralyze or sleep. (25% each) Contact.

moves.name: Disable
moves.text: For four turns, this move prevents the target from using the move it last used.

moves.name: Disarming Voice
moves.text: Letting out a charming cry, the user subdues the foes. This ALWAYS drops BOTH of the foe's offensive stats by 1.

moves.name: Dismal Cry
moves.text: The user unleashes a cry fueled by negative emotion, disheartening the foes. This ALWAYS drops offensive stats by 1.

moves.name: Dive
moves.text: The user dives down, striking the target on the next turn. This boosts the Accuracy by 1 after use, & bypasses protect. Contact.

moves.name: Divebomb
moves.text: The user recklessly dives onto the target from above. If this misses or fails, the user loses half of it's max HP. Contact.

moves.name: Doodle
moves.text: The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. Changes the Abilities of the user and its ally to that of the target.

moves.name: Doom Desire
moves.text: The user yearns for the target's demise, striking the target with a blast of dark energy 2 turns after the move is used. ALWAYS crits.

moves.name: Double Hit
moves.text: The user strikes the foe twice in succession. Each hit has a 15% flinch rate, for a total of 27%. Contact.

moves.name: Double Kick
moves.text: The target is kicked twice in succession using both feet. This hits twice. Each hit has a 15% chance to flinch. 27% overall. Contact.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.text: A reckless, life-risking tackle. The user takes 33% recoil damage. This has a 50% chance to lower the foe's Defense by 1. Contact.

moves.name: Draco Jet
moves.text: The user strikes the target with immense speed and vigor. Hits twice, ALWAYS crits, & has +3 priority. Can't be used 2x in a row.

moves.name: Draco Meteor
moves.text: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. This drops the user's Sp. Atk by 2 after use.

moves.name: Dragon Ascent
moves.text: The user descends onto the foe from the sky with drakonic force. This drops the user's Attack stat by 2 after use. Contact.

moves.name: Dragon Breath
moves.text: The user exhales a destructive breath of dragon energy. This burns the target 30% of the time.

moves.name: Dragon Cheer
moves.text: The user raises the morale of its allies. +1 crit rate for allies. +2 if they are Dragon-type.

moves.name: Dragon Claw
moves.text: The user rakes the target with claws or scythes imbued with drakonic energy. This has a 50% (+2) crit rate. Contact.

moves.name: Dragon Dance
moves.text: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that raises its Attack and Speed by 1. -1 Priority.

moves.name: Dragon Energy
moves.text: The user unleashes a massive blast of dragon energy. Damage decreases the less HP the user has, with 150 BP at full HP.

moves.name: Dragon Hammer
moves.text: The user hammers down on the opponent. This deals 33% recoil, and has a 50% chance to drop the foe's Defense. Contact.

moves.name: Dragon Pulse
moves.text: The user releases a destructive shockwave of dragon energy. This paralyzes the target 30% of the time.

moves.name: Dragon Rush
moves.text: The user tackles the foe while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This has a 30% flinch rate. Contact.

moves.name: Dragon Tail
moves.text: The user slams the target with it's tail, dragging out a different Pokemon. This always goes last, and can't miss. Contact. -6 Prio.

moves.name: Dragon's Blade
moves.text: The user slashes with a powerful blade. ALWAYS crits. User takes 2x damage until next attack. No use 2x in a row. Contact.

moves.name: Dragon's Fury
moves.text: The user unleashes a chaotic blast of dragon's breath at the foe. This ALWAYS leaves the foe with a burn.

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.text: The user attacks the foe with an energy-draining punch. This heals the user by 50% of damage dealt. Contact.

moves.name: Draining Kiss
moves.text: The user steals the target's HP with an energy depleting kiss. This heals the user by 75% of damage dealt. Contact.

moves.name: Drakonic Beam
moves.text: The user unleashes a destructive beam fueled by the user's dragon energy. Deals 33% recoil, 50% chance to drop Sp. Def.

moves.name: Drakonic Voice
moves.text: The user unleashes a destructive soundwave or blast imbued with dragon energy.

moves.name: Dream Eater
moves.text: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. Restores the user's HP by ALL of the damage dealt. +1 Priority.

moves.name: Dreamy Kiss
moves.text: The user kisses the target dreamily, causing the target to fall asleep for 2 turns.

moves.name: Drill Peck
moves.text: A corkscrewing attack with a sharp appendage acting as a drill. This attack has a 50% (+2) crit rate. Contact.

moves.name: Drill Run
moves.text: The user crashes into the target while rotating its body or appendage like a drill. This has a 50% (+2) crit rate. Contact.

moves.name: Drum Beating
moves.text: Rillaboom plays its drum with great intensity, controlling the drum's roots to attack. Lowers Speed AND Defense by -1.

moves.name: Dual Wingbeat
moves.text: The user strikes the foe twice with its wings. Each strike has a 15% chance to flinch. 27% overall. Contact.

moves.name: Dynamax Cannon
moves.text: Eternatus releases a strange, corrupt beam. This ALWAYS poisons, and heals 50% of damage dealt.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.text: The user makes the ground under the target erupt. This has a 30% chance to drop the foe's Sp. Def by 1.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.text: The user creates an earthquake, damaging all but the user.

moves.name: Echoed Voice
moves.text: The user unleashes an echoing voice. This gains 40 BP for each use, and +1 Sp. Atk for each use.

moves.name: Eerie Spell
moves.text: The user performs a mysterious spell, boosting the user's Sp. Atk by 1, and decreasing PP of the target's last move by 3.

moves.name: Electric Terrain
moves.text: The user changes the terrain to electric terrian, affecting all grounded Pokemon. +1 Priority.

moves.name: Electro Assault
moves.text: The user floats with electromagnetism, and dives onto the foe as if they were a bolt of lightning. Drops user's Atk by -2. Contact.

moves.name: Electro Ball
moves.text: The user hurls an electric orb at the foe. The faster you are than them, the stronger this is. ALWAYS boosts Speed by 1 after use.

moves.name: Electro Drift
moves.text: The user crashes into the target, spinning with great force. Deals 30% more if SE. 50% recoil. -1 Defenses. +1 Speed. Contact.

moves.name: Electro Shot
moves.text: The user gathers electricity for a turn, boosting Sp. Atk by 1 first. After, a high-voltage shot is fired. No charge in rain. ALWAYS crits.

moves.name: Electroweb
moves.text: The user attacks the opposing Pokemon with an electric net. This ALWAYS lowers the Speed of those hit by 2.

moves.name: Encore
moves.text: The user compels the target to keep using the move it last used for three turns.

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.text: The user makes a desperate attack, cutting down the foe's HP to equal the user's current HP. Contact.

moves.name: Endure
moves.text: The user braces itself, surving any attack that would've knocked it out otherwise. Hard to use consecutively. +6 Priority.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.text: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This has a 25% chance to drop the foe's Sp. Def by 1.

moves.name: Engorge
moves.text: The user consumes whatever berry it's holding at the moment. In addition to the berry effect, both defenses are raised by 1.

moves.name: Enrich
moves.text: The user replenishes the cream on their body. This heals by 2/3 HP.

moves.name: Entrainment
moves.text: The user influences the target, changing the target's ability to match the user's.

moves.name: Eruption
moves.text: The user attacks the foes with a furious blast of fire. The lower the user's HP, the lower this move's power. If full HP, 150 BP.

moves.name: Esper Wing
moves.text: The user slashes with aura enriched wings, boosting it's Speed stat by 1 after use. This ALWAYS crits.

moves.name: Eternal Beam
moves.text: The user unleashes a perilous beam fueled by its own life force. This deals 33% recoil, & has a 50% chance to drop Sp. Def by 1.

moves.name: Expanding Force
moves.text: This unique psychic blast increases in power by 50% when under Psychic Terrain, and becomes a spread move.

moves.name: Explosion
moves.text: The user desperately explodes, causing maximum damage. This ALWAYS results in a critical hit.

moves.name: Extrasensory
moves.text: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. This has a 30% flinch rate.

moves.name: Extreme Speed
moves.text: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This has +3 Priority, and can't miss. Contact.

moves.name: Facade
moves.text: The user attacks, feigning weakness. If the user is statused, the power of this doubles. Contact.

moves.name: Fake Out
moves.text: The user fakes the target out, flinching the foe. This can only be used on the 1st turn. Has +5 Priority. Contact.

moves.name: Fake Tears
moves.text: The user pretends to cry, lowering their guard and dropping the foe's Sp. Def AND Speed by 1.

moves.name: False Surrender
moves.text: Kingambit bows down to the target- then slashes when they least expect. +4 priority, ALWAYS crits, ALWAYS flinches. Contact.

moves.name: Feather Ball
moves.text: The user fires a concentrated ball of feathers and wind at the foe. This ALWAYS drops BOTH of the foe's offensive stats by 1.

moves.name: Feather Dance
moves.text: The user performs a display with it's feathers. This drops the target's Attack by 2.

moves.name: Fickle Beam
moves.text: User unleashes a beam from one of it's mouths. ALWAYS CRITS. 1/3 of the time, all headsattack, doubling the power.

moves.name: Fiery Dance
moves.text: The user performs a dance while cloaked in flames. This has a 50% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1 stage.

moves.name: Fiery Wrath
moves.text: The user's resentment overflows and fuels a harsh, fire-like attack. This ALWAYS inflicts a burn on the foes.

moves.name: Fillet Away
moves.text: Veluza fillets itself at the cost of 50% of it's max HP. In exchange, this boosts Atk/Sp. Atk and Speed by 2. -1 Prio.

moves.name: Final Gambit
moves.text: The user risks it all to attack the foe. The user faints, and deals damage equal to their HP stat at the time of using this move.

moves.name: Finishing Blow
moves.text: The user jabs at the foe's critical weakpoint. This ALWAYS results in a critical hit, & gives +3 Attack if it knocks out the foe. Contact.

moves.name: Fire Blast
moves.text: The target is attacked with an intense blast of flames. This burns the target 30% of the time.

moves.name: Fire Fang
moves.text: The user bites the foe with flaming fangs. This has a 20% flinch rate, and a 10% chance to burn the foe. Contact.

moves.name: Fire Lash
moves.text: The user quickly cracks its tail like a burning whip, startling the foe. ALWAYS flinches, crits, +4 priority, drops Defense. Contact.

moves.name: Fire Pledge
moves.text: A column of fire damages the foe. This has a 25% chance to boost Sp. Atk by 1. This can be combined with another pledge.

moves.name: Fire Punch
moves.text: The target is punched with a fiery fist. This has a 10% chance to burn the foe. Contact.

moves.name: Fire Spin
moves.text: The target becomes trapped within a vortex of fire that traps foe for 3-5 turns, preventing switching and dealing 12% of the foe's HP.

moves.name: First Impression
moves.text: The user delivers a quick, potent blow. +4 Priority, & only works the 1st turn on the field. ALWAYS crits. Contact.

moves.name: Fissure
moves.text: The user opens a fissure under the target, instantly fainting it. This can't miss, but can only be used once per battle.

moves.name: Flail
moves.text: The user flails about aimlessly. The less HP the user has, the greater the move's power. This can't miss, and makes contact.

moves.name: Flame Wheel
moves.text: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target spinning. This ALWAYS boosts the user's Speed by 1. Contact.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.text: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This burns the target 10% of the time.

moves.name: Flare Blitz
moves.text: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. This has 33% recoil, and a 25% chance to burn the foe. Contact.

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.text: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. This has a 50% chance to lower Special Defense.

moves.name: Flatter
moves.text: The user flatters the target, confusing them for 3 turns, & raising their Sp. Atk by 6.

moves.name: Fling
moves.text: User flings its item. Has +4 Priority, and ALWAYS flinches. Iron Ball 130 BP, Flame/Toxic Orb and Light Ball 100 BP+Status.

moves.name: Flip Turn
moves.text: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting. Contact.

moves.name: Floral Healing
moves.text: The user heals itself by 50% of it's max HP. This restores 2/3 HP under Grassy Terrain.

moves.name: Flower Trick
moves.text: Meowscarada throws a rigged bouqet of flowers. This ALWAYS results in a critical hit.

moves.name: Fly
moves.text: The user soars and then strikes its target on the next turn. This boosts Accuracy by 1 after use. Contact.

moves.name: Flying Press
moves.text: Hawlucha dives with full force onto the foe. Deals Fighting & Flying damage at the same time. 50% recoil, -1 Defenses.

moves.name: Focus Blast
moves.text: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes a massive blast of aura energy. This lowers Sp. Def 50% of the time.

moves.name: Focus Energy
moves.text: The user itensifies it's focus. This gives +2 crit rate, making standard moves crit 50% of the time.

moves.name: Focus Punch
moves.text: The user focuses to land a powerful punch, failing if hit while focusing. Gives +1 Accuracy/Attack, ALWAYS crits. Contact. -3 Prio.

moves.name: Follow Me
moves.text: The user draws attention to itself, making all opponents only attack the user. +6 Priority.

moves.name: Force Waves
moves.text: The user forms 2 shockwaves from it's palms. This hits twice, and each hit has a 50% paralysis chance.

moves.name: Forest's Curse
moves.text: The user curses the foe, dealing 25% of their HP at the end of each turn. This doesn't cost any HP to use.

moves.name: Fortify
moves.text: The user fortifies the metal on its body. This heals the user by 50% of their max HP.

moves.name: Foul Play
moves.text: This devious attack uses the target's strength against itself, using the target's Attack stat instead of their own. Contact.

moves.name: Freeze-Dry
moves.text: The user rapidly cools the target. This has a 10% chance to freeze the foe. This move is super effective on Water-type Pokemon.

moves.name: Freezing Glare
moves.text: The user glares at the foe, then shoots powerful beams from its eyes. This ALWAYS crits, & drops the foe's Atk/Sp. Atk/Speed by 1.

moves.name: Frenzy Plant
moves.text: The user assaults the target with roots from below in a frenzy. This lowers the user's Attack by 2 after use.

moves.name: Frost Breath
moves.text: The user blows freezing, abrasive breath at the target. This ALWAYS results in a critical hit.

moves.name: Frost Flurry
moves.text: The user attacks with a rapid flurry of snow or ice. This has +1 Priority, and can't miss.

moves.name: Fury Cutter
moves.text: The user slashes angrily at the foe. This doubles in power each use, user gets +1 attack each time. ALWAYS CRITS. Contact.

moves.name: Fury Pecks
moves.text: The user furiously jabs at the target 2-5 times in a row. Contact.

moves.name: Fury Swipes
moves.text: The target is raked furiously with sharp claws, scythes, or the like. This hits 2-5 times in a row. Contact.

moves.name: Future Sight
moves.text: The user foresees a very powerful psychic blast that will strike the target 2 turns after the move is used. ALWAYS crits.

moves.name: Game Plan
moves.text: The user formulates a game plan on the spot. This gives +1 Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.text: A strong nutrient-draining attack. This user's HP is restored by 50% of the damage dealt.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.text: The user charges with incredible force, using all of it's strength. This drops the user's Attack by 2 after use.

moves.name: Gigaton Hammer
moves.text: Tinkaton slams the foe with its ginormous hammer. This can't be used 2x in a row.

moves.name: Glare
moves.text: The user intimidates the target with a glare. This paralyzes the foe, and lowers offenses by 1.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.text: The user snares the target with grass and trips it, lowering their Speed by 1. The heavier the foe, the stronger this is. Contact.

moves.name: Grass Pledge
moves.text: A column of grass damages the foe. This has a 25% chance to boost Sp. Atk by 1. This can be combined with another pledge.

moves.name: Grassy Glide
moves.text: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks swiftly. This has +1 priority ONLY when under Grassy Terrain.

moves.name: Grassy Terrain
moves.text: The user changes the terrain to grassy terrian, affecting all grounded Pokemon. +1 Priority.

moves.name: Grav Apple
moves.text: Flapple drops an apple on the foe, starling them. ALWAYS flinches, doubles if Gravity is up, +4 priority, drops Defense by 1.

moves.name: Gravity
moves.text: The user itensifies gravity for 5 turns, grounding all , increasing accuracy stats by 1.67, & more. More moves are affected now.

moves.name: Growl
moves.text: The user growls, dropping the foe's Attack & Speed stats by 1.

moves.name: Growth
moves.text: The user's body grows, raising it's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1, or 2 under the Sun.

moves.name: Guard Split
moves.text: The user's averages defensive stats with the target.

moves.name: Guard Swap
moves.text: The user's swaps defensive stat changes with the target. This has +4 priority.

moves.name: Guillotine
moves.text: The target is cut in half, instantly fainting it. This can't miss, but can only be used once per battle. Contact.

moves.name: Gunk Shot
moves.text: The user shoots filthy, dense gunk at the target with force. This has a 50% chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Gust
moves.text: A weak gust of wind is quickly whipped up and launched at the foe. This has +1 Priority, and can't miss.

moves.name: Gyro Ball
moves.text: Spinning, the user rams the foe. The slower the user is compared to the foe, the stronger this is. Lowers user's Speed by 1. Contact.

moves.name: Hammer Arm
moves.text: The user slams its heavy fist down onto the foe. Lowers the user's Speed by 1. Contact.

moves.name: Hard Press
moves.text: The target is crushed between the user's arms, claws, or similar. Varies in power with target's HP. (Full HP = 100 BP) Contact.

moves.name: Harmonize
moves.text: The user attacks with it's voice. Others can join in to increase the power. This ALWAYS drops BOTH of the foe's offensive stats by 1.

moves.name: Haze
moves.text: The user eliminates every stat change on the field.

moves.name: Head Smash
moves.text: The user recklessly smashes head-first into the target. This deals 50% recoil, AND lowers Defensive stats by 1. Contact.

moves.name: Headbutt
moves.text: The user tackles the foe head-first. This has a 30% flinch chance. Contact.

moves.name: Headlong Rush
moves.text: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This lowers the user's Defensive stats by 1 after use. Contact.

moves.name: Heal Bell
moves.text: The user releases a soothing chime sound that heals your whole party of status conditions. +4 Priority.

moves.name: Heal Pulse
moves.text: The user emits a healing wave, healing the target by 100% of their max HP.

moves.name: Healing Wish
moves.text: The user faints itself, and its dying wish fully heals the next weakened Pokemon sent into battle.

moves.name: Heart Swap
moves.text: The user swaps ALL stat changes with the foe. This has +4 priority.

moves.name: Heat Crash
moves.text: The user slams onto the foe cloaked in flames. Grows stronger the more the user outweighs the foe. 30% Burn rate. Contact.

moves.name: Heat Wave
moves.text: The user blows a burning, abrasive wind at the foes. This ALWAYS results in a critical hit. 20% burn rate.

moves.name: Heavy Slam
moves.text: The user slams onto the foe with its heavy body. 30% flinch. Grows stronger the more the user outweighs the foe. Contact.

moves.name: Hell Thrust
moves.text: A straight-forward attack in which user lunges toward the target violenty. This deals 20% recoil, and has a 30% flinch rate. Contact.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.text: The user assists an ally, boosting the power of their attack by 50%. This has +6 priority.

moves.name: Hex
moves.text: This sinister attack deals double damage to a foe with a status condition.

moves.name: High Horsepower
moves.text: The user bucks at the foe, then kicks twice with its powerful legs. This hits TWICE, and drops foe's Atk/Sp. Atk each time.

moves.name: High Jump Kick
moves.text: The user leaps in the air and kicks feet-first. If this misses or fails, the user takes 50% crash damage. Contact.

moves.name: High Voltage
moves.text: The user unleashes an intense electrical shock onto the foe. This ALWAYS results in a critical hit, can't be used 2x in a row.

moves.name: Hold Back
moves.text: The user goes easy on the foe so they don't knock it out. Boosts Attack/Acc by 1, +4 Priority, ALWAYS flinches.

moves.name: Hone Claws
moves.text: The user hones its claws, blades or the like. This boosts the user's Attack by 1, and Accuracy by 2.

moves.name: Hoodwink
moves.text: The user unleashes an unexpectedly vicious blow after putting on a cute act to steal the target's item. 30% flinch rate. Contact.

moves.name: Horn Drill
moves.text: The target is drilled through, instantly fainting it. This can't miss, but can only be used once per battle. Contact.

moves.name: Horn Leech
moves.text: The user stabs the foe with its wooden horns and drains their health. This heals 50% of the damage dealt. Contact.

moves.name: Howl
moves.text: The user howls loudly, rousing themselves up. This boosts the Attack, Sp. Atk & Accuracy of the user and allies by 2. -1 Priority.

moves.name: Hurricane
moves.text: The user attacks by surrounding its opponent in a fierce vortex of wind. Can't miss in rain. Confuses 30% of the time for 5 turns.

moves.name: Hydro Assault
moves.text: The user attacks the foe with enough power to climb waterfalls. This drops the user's Attack by 2 stages after use, however.

moves.name: Hydro Cannon
moves.text: The target is seized by a watery blast. This drops the user's Sp. Atk by 2 after use, however.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.text: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.name: Hydro Steam
moves.text: The user blasts the foe with boiling-hot water. Boosted by 1.5x in Sun. ALWAYS burns.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.text: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. This drops the user's Sp. Atk by 2 after use.

moves.name: Hyper Drill
moves.text: The user pierces the target with its spinning pointed body or appendage. ALWAYS crits, can't be used 2x in a row. Contact.

moves.name: Hyper Voice
moves.text: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage. 30% chance to flinch.

moves.name: Hyperspace Fury
moves.text: Hoopa Unbound unleashes its fury. This drops Hoopa's Defenses by 1, and deals 50% recoil. Contact.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.text: The user employs hypnotic suggestion, putting the target to sleep for 2 turns.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.text: A frozen beam of energy is shot at the target. This has a 10% chance to freeze the foe.

moves.name: Ice Breaker
moves.text: The user freezes the foe in place and impales them with an icicle. This ALWAYS lands a critical hit, can't be used 2x in a row.

moves.name: Ice Burn
moves.text: Arcanine charges up its fiery spirit for a turn, and unleashes a massive icy blast after. ALWAYS crits, boosts Atk/Sp. Atk after use.

moves.name: Ice Fang
moves.text: The user bites the foe with frozen fangs. This has a 25% flinch rate, and a 10% chance to freeze the foe. Contact.

moves.name: Ice Hammer
moves.text: The user wildly swings a heavy appendage encased in ice. This deals 33% recoil, & drops Defense 30% of the time. Contact.

moves.name: Ice Punch
moves.text: The target is punched with an icy fist. This has a 10% chance to freeze the foe. Contact.

moves.name: Ice Shard
moves.text: The user flash-freezes shards of ice and shoots them at the foe. This has +1 Priority, and can't miss.

moves.name: Ice Spinner
moves.text: The user spins around, slamming into the target. This destroys any terrain, AND boosts Speed by 1 after use. Contact.

moves.name: Icicle Crash
moves.text: The user harshly slams large icicles onto the target. This flinches 30% of the time.

moves.name: Icicle Spear
moves.text: The user launches 2-5 sharp icicles at the opponent.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.text: The user attacks with a gust of freezing air. This ALWAYS lowers the foe's Speed stat by 2.

moves.name: Ignite
moves.text: The user quickly ignites and shoots a weak flame. This has +1 Priority, and can't miss.

moves.name: Imprison
moves.text: The user prevents the foe from using any moves it currently knows. +6 Priority.

moves.name: Infernal Parade
moves.text: The user releases a myriad flames fueled by spiritual energy. This ALWAYS burns, and doubles in power if the target is statused.

moves.name: Inferno
moves.text: The user engulfs the target in a catastrophic inferno of fire. This ALWAYS leaves the target with a burn.

moves.name: Infestation
moves.text: The target becomes infested with a pestilence, trapping the foe for 3-5 turns, preventing switching & dealing 12% of the foe's HP.

moves.name: Influx
moves.text: The user fires a psychic beam faster than the opponent can react. This has +1 priority.

moves.name: Ingrain
moves.text: On top of Ingrain's old heal/trap effect, this boosts the user's Sp. Def & Sp. Atk by 3, but drops Speed by 3.

moves.name: Instruct
moves.text: Oranguru instructs the target to use the move they just used again.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.text: The user hardens its body's surface to iron-like hardness. This raises Defense by 2.

moves.name: Iron Head
moves.text: The user rams the target with its steel-hard head. This flinches the target 30% of the time. Contact.

moves.name: Iron Tail
moves.text: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This has a 50% chance to drop the foe's Defense by 1. Contact.

moves.name: Ivy Cudgel
moves.text: Ogrepon strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. Changes type to match held mask. ALWAYS crits.

moves.name: Jackpot
moves.text: Congrats, you won! This will boost ALL your stats! But- you neglected to pay taxes, so you'll faint in 4 turns if you don't switch or run away.

moves.name: Jagged Edge
moves.text: The target is slashed violently with jagged claws, blades, or the like. This has a 50% (+2) crit rate. Contact.

moves.name: Jaw Lock
moves.text: User bites down hard and doesn't let go, gnawing each turn. Locks user in with the target. Deals 12% HP for 3-5 turns. Contact.

moves.name: Jet Punch
moves.text: With a torrent around its fist, the user punches at blinding speed. +3 Priority, ALWAYS crits, can't be used 2x in a row. Contact.

moves.name: Jungle Healing
moves.text: The user employs the power of the jungle to heal itself and allies This has +4 priority, heals ALL HP.

moves.name: Kerfuffle
moves.text: User attacks boisterously for 2-3 turns, confusing themselves once finished. Gives +1 Atk for each use. Contact.

moves.name: Knock Off
moves.text: The user hits the target's held item off, removing it until the end of battle. This deals 1.5x damage if it removes an item. Contact.

moves.name: Knockout Punch
moves.text: The user punches the foe with great force. The resulting fatigue causes the target to fall asleep after the next turn. Contact.

moves.name: Laceration
moves.text: The target is slashed viciously with steel-hard claws, blades, or the like. This has a 50% (+2) crit rate. Contact.

moves.name: Land's Wrath
moves.text: The user focuses their rage on the ground below the foe, causing magma to spew out. This ALWAYS burns, and ALWAYS crits.

moves.name: Lash Out
moves.text: The user lashes out violenty. If the user's stats were lowered this turn at all, this DOUBLES in power. ALWAYS crits. Contact.

moves.name: Last Resort
moves.text: This desperate attack can only be used if user has no other moves left. Contact. ALWAYS CRITS, can't be used 2x in a row.

moves.name: Last Respects
moves.text: The user pays respects for their fallen allies. This increases by 50 power for each ally that has fainted.

moves.name: Lava Plume
moves.text: The user unleashes a burning plume of magma around itself. This ALWAYS burns those who are hit.

moves.name: Leaf Blade
moves.text: The user vicously slashes the foe with a blade made of leaves. This has a 50% (+2) crit rate. Contact.

moves.name: Leaf Flurry
moves.text: The user quickly whips up a flurry of leaves at the foe. This has +1 Priority, and can't miss.

moves.name: Leaf Storm
moves.text: The user whips up a massive storm of leaves around the foe. This lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2 after use.

moves.name: Leech Life
moves.text: The user drains the target's vital fluids. The user's HP is restored by 100% of the damage dealt.

moves.name: Leech Seed
moves.text: A seed is planted on the target. It steals 12% HP from the target every turn.

moves.name: Leer
moves.text: The user gives opposing Pokemon an intimidating glance, lowering their Defense AND Speed by 1.

moves.name: Life Dew
moves.text: The user hydrates its side of the field with mysterious water. This has +4 priority, and heals ALL HP.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.text: A wondrous wall of light is put up to halve damage from Special Attacks for 5 turns.

moves.name: Liquidation
moves.text: The user batters the target with a full-force blast of water. This ALWAYS lowers the foe's Defense by 1. Contact.

moves.name: Low Kick
moves.text: The user kicks the foe's legs, tripping it, lowering their Speed by 1. The heavier the foe, the stronger this becomes. Contact.

moves.name: Low Sweep
moves.text: The user makes a swift attack at the foe using its legs. Drops Speed by 2. Contact.

moves.name: Lumina Crash
moves.text: The user unleashes a massive burst of peculiar light. Deals 33% recoil, and has a 50% chance to lower the foe's Sp. Def by 2.

moves.name: Lunar Blessing
moves.text: The user absorbs energy from the moon to heal itself and allies. This heals 100% HP, status conditions, and has +4 Priority.

moves.name: Lunar Dance
moves.text: The user absorbs energy from the moon and dances. This boosts the user's Attack/Sp. Atk by 1, & Speed by 2. -1 Priority.

moves.name: Lunge
moves.text: The user lunges at the foe with full force. This ALWAYS drops the foe's offensive stats. Contact.

moves.name: Lustrous Power
moves.text: The user releases a miraculous and intense gleam of light. This boosts Sp. Atk by 1 guaranteed. AI Only move.

moves.name: Mach Punch
moves.text: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. This has +1 Priority, and can't miss. Contact.

moves.name: Magic Powder
moves.text: The user scatters magical dust that turns the target into a pure Psychic type.

moves.name: Magic Room
moves.text: For 5 turns, held items have no effect for all Pokemon on the field. ALWAYS goes first.

moves.name: Magnet Rise
moves.text: The user levitates for 5 turns using electrically generated magnetism.

moves.name: Make It Rain
moves.text: Gholdengo showers the opponent with coins from its own body. This lowers your Defenses by 1 as a result of losing coins.

moves.name: Malignant Chain
moves.text: The user wraps the foe in a corrosive, toxic chain. This ALWAYS crits, and ALWAYS badly poisons the foe.

moves.name: Matcha Gotcha
moves.text: Poltchageist fires a blast of hot matcha. This ALWAYS burns, AND heals the user by 100% of damage dealt. Can't be used 2x in a row.

moves.name: Mega Drain
moves.text: A nutrient-draining attack. This user's HP is restored by 75% of the damage dealt.

moves.name: Megahorn
moves.text: The user rams its impressive horn into the target with no letup. This lowers the user's Defensive stats by 1 after use. Contact.

moves.name: Megaton Kick
moves.text: The user launches a kick towards the ground with massive force. This flinches 30% of the time. Contact.

moves.name: Memento
moves.text: The user faints, dropping the target's Sp. Atk & Attack by 2 stages. This has +4 Priority.

moves.name: Mesmer-Eyes
moves.text: The user mesmerizes the target, putting them to sleep for 2 turns using it's eyes. This move fails on Ghost-types.

moves.name: Metal Burst
moves.text: The user moves last, dealing 1.5x damage taken back to the target with a burst attack.

moves.name: Metal Claw
moves.text: The target is raked with a steel-hard claw, talon, scythe or the like. This has a 12%, or +1 critical hit rate. Contact.

moves.name: Metal Sound
moves.text: A horrible sound like scraping metal drops the foe's Sp. Def & Sp. Atk by 2.

moves.name: Meteor Beam
moves.text: The user gathers energy, boosting it's Sp. Atk by 1 first, then fires a powerful beam on the 2nd turn. ALWAYS crits.

moves.name: Meteor Impact
moves.text: The user descends like a meteor from the sky. Has 50% recoil, ignores foe abils, and ALWAYS burns.

moves.name: Meteor Mash
moves.text: The user punches with cosmic force, astonishing the foe. ALWAYS flinches, has +4 priority, and a 50% to boost Attack. Contact.

moves.name: Mighty Cleave
moves.text: Iron Boulder gathers energy on its horn, then cleaves the target. This ALWAYS crits, and gives +1 Sp. Def.

moves.name: Mimic
moves.text: The user copies the target's last move and can use it during battle until they switch out. +6 Priority.

moves.name: Mind Pulse
moves.text: The target is hit by a weak telekinectic force. This ALWAYS drops the offensive stats of the target by 1.

moves.name: Mineral Shower
moves.text: The user whips up a storm of minerals, gems, crystals, or the like. This lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat by 2 after use.

moves.name: Mirror Coat
moves.text: The user moves last, reflecting 2x damage taken from any Special Attack back to the target. -5 Prio.

moves.name: Mirror Cutter
moves.text: The user launches particle blades at the target. This hits TWICE, and ALWAYS crits.

moves.name: Mist
moves.text: The user cloaks its side of the field in a white mist, preventing their stats from being lowered for 5 turns. +4 Priority.

moves.name: Misty Explosion
moves.text: The user explodes in a misty blast. This ALWAYS crits, and increases by an additional 50% if terrain is up.

moves.name: Misty Terrain
moves.text: The user changes the terrain to misty terrian, affecting all grounded Pokemon. This has +1 Priority.

moves.name: Molt
moves.text: The user sheds its skin or exoskeleton, healing the user by 50% of their max HP.

moves.name: Moonblast

moves.name: Protect
moves.text: Too broken with setup + inf relearner. A lot of counterplay to setup is a QC mon in the back, protecting on QC negates that. Also, protect is only really used by the player for stalling extra healing turns, or generally cheesing/exploiting anyways. Not like this is 6v6 singles, or VGC where protect is an important and useful tool- it's just a cheese option. In Sweltering Sun, I'm okay with it since it requires using up a valuable moveslot- but here? It's just way too broken for setup and stall. Stall is still great with pivoting/exploiting AI, you can still trigger your Toxic/Flame orbs by simply switching in, etc. Seems drastic on paper but I think it will be very good for the overall balance of the hack to not allow completely free cheese on QC/stalling the AI. In addition, all of the strong guaranteed critical hit moves have the new effect to not hit 2x in a row. With protect, this downside only affects things such as Scarf+crit move, but removing Protect makes this drawback far more potent and effective in what I want it to do. Moves like Spiky, Baneful, etc are still usable since they have restricting flavor, making them more unique tools.

moves.text: The user lays a sticky trap around the foe's side, lowering the Speed of any foes who switch in by 1.

moves.name: Stinger Missile
moves.text: The user fires poisonous stingers at the foe 2-5 times in a row. This ALWAYS Poisons the target.

moves.name: Stockpile
moves.text: The user stockpiles energy, which raises it's Defense & Sp. Def stats by 1. You can only get +3 at a time at most.

moves.name: Stomp
moves.text: The target is stomped on. This has a 30% chance to flinch. Contact.

moves.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.text: Driven by frustration, the user stomps the ground around itself. If the user's previous move failed/missed, the BP of this doubles.

moves.name: Stone Axe
moves.text: Kleavor swings its stone axes at the target, ALWAYS landing a critical hit. This leaves Stealth Rocks on the field after. Contact.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.text: The user stabs the target from below with jagged stones. This ALWAYS results in a critical hit, can't be used 2x in a row.

moves.name: Stored Power
moves.text: The user attacks with more power the more stat boosts it has. User gets +1 Sp. Atk after each use. +20 BP for a boost.

moves.name: Strange Impulse
moves.text: The user's body emits a bizarre, unnerving impulse. This lowers the Sp. Atk of the foes by 2.

moves.name: Strange Steam
moves.text: The user expels a peculiar steam at the foes. This ALWAYS lowers Attack, Sp. Atk and Speed of those hit by 1 stage.

moves.name: Strength
moves.text: The user batters the foe with its hard body with enough force to move boulders. This deals 33% recoil. 20% flinch. Contact.

moves.name: Strength Sap
moves.text: The user drains the foe's life force. This recovers HP equal to the foe's Attack stat, and drops Attack by 1.

moves.name: String Shot
moves.text: The opposing Pokemon are bound with silk. This lowers Speed by 2, and both offensive stats by 1.

moves.name: Struggle Bug
moves.text: While resisting, the user attacks the opposing Pokemon. This ALWAYS drops BOTH of the foe's offensive stats by 1.

moves.name: Stun Spore
moves.text: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Subspace Tear
moves.text: Using psychic powers, the user tears the space around the foe. ALWAYS result in a critical hit, can't be used 2x in a row.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.text: The user makes a decoy using 25% of it's HP. This decoy can absorb most attacks for the user.

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.text: The user sucker punches the foe. This fails if the foe isn't using an attacking move. This has +2 priority, and can't miss. Contact.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.text: The user summons strong sunlight. +1 Priority.

moves.name: Super Fang
moves.text: The user swiftly chomps on the foe with its sharp front fangs. This cuts the target's HP in half & ALWAYS flinches. +4 Priority. Contact.

moves.name: Supercell Slam
moves.text: The user slams onto the foe with its electrified body. If this misses or fails, the user takes 50% recoil. 30% to paralyze. Contact.

moves.name: Superpower
moves.text: The user attacks the target with great power. In exchange, this lowers the user's Attack by 2 after use. Contact.

moves.name: Surf
moves.text: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave of water.

moves.name: Surging Strikes
moves.text: The user repeatedly strikes the target with the force of a tsunami. Hits 3 times, ALWAYS crits, can't be used 2x in a row. Contact.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.text: The user enrages the target, confusing them for 3 turns, & raising their Attack by 6, making them hit themselves harder.

moves.name: Swallow
moves.text: The user swallows any stat boosts it has stockpiled. 25% for 1, 50% for 2, 100% for 3. User loses Stockpile boosts. +4 Priority.

moves.name: Sweet Scent
moves.text: The user releases a scent to entice the foe, making them unaware. This drops Atk, Sp. Atk & Sp. Def by 1.

moves.name: Swift
moves.text: Star-shaped rays are rapidly shot at the foe. This has +1 priority, and can't miss.

moves.name: Switcheroo
moves.text: The user swaps the target's held item with their own. +4 Priority.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.text: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This raises the user's Attack by 2. -1 Priority.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.text: The user heals itself by 50% of it's max HP. This restores 2/3 HP in the Sun, and 1/3 HP in other weather.

moves.name: Syrup Bomb
moves.text: The user sends an explosion of sticky syrup at the foe. This ALWAYS crits, & drops Speed by 1 for 3-5 turns after use.

moves.name: Tail Slap
moves.text: The user attacks by striking hard with it's tail. This hits 2-5 times in a row. Contact.

moves.name: Tail Wag
moves.text: The user wags its tail cutely, making foes less wary, dropping both defense stats by 1. This has +4 Priority.

moves.name: Tailwind
moves.text: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that doubles the Speed stat of your party for 4 turns.

moves.name: Take Aim
moves.text: The user takes aim at the target, boosting both offensive stats and accuracy by +3.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.text: The performs a take down on the foe. The user takes 20% recoil damage. This lowers the foe's Defense 30% of the time. Contact.

moves.name: Take Heart
moves.text: The user employs unique psychic abilities. This cures any potential status conditions, boosts all stats by 1, but drops Speed by -2. -1 Priority.

moves.name: Tar Shot
moves.text: The user coats the targets in a sticky tar. Doubles the damage of Fire, drops their Speed by 5 stages- +4 priority, ALWAYS flinches.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.text: The user taunts the foe into a rage that forces it to only use attacking moves for 3 turns.

moves.name: Tearful Look
moves.text: The user gets teary eyed, lowering the foe's spirit, dropping offensive AND speed stats by 1.

moves.name: Teatime
moves.text: Poltegeist drinks its own tea, boosting Defense, Sp. Def and Sp. Atk by 1. -1 Priority.

moves.name: Teeter Dance
moves.text: The user performs a unique, disorienting dance, boosting ALL stats by 1, but confusing themselves in the process.

moves.name: Teleport
moves.text: The user moves last, teleporting off of the field and switching places with a different party member.

moves.name: Temper Flare
moves.text: The user's temper flares up. Doubles in power if last move failed. This ALWAYS crits, and can't be used 2x in a row. Contact.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.text: The user attacks with terastal energy. Becomes physical or special based on highest stat if Tera'd. 50% to drop both Defenses.

moves.name: Terrain Pulse
moves.text: The user fires off a pulse of energy that changes type & doubles in power based on the terrain. This drops Sp. Def 50% of the time.

moves.name: Thief
moves.text: The user attacks, stealing the target's held item. The user can't steal an item if it already holds one. Contact.

moves.name: Think Fast
moves.text: The user uses its intelligence to outmanuever the foe, throwing a quick punch. +2 priority, lifts Protect, & can't miss.

moves.name: Throat Chop
moves.text: The user jabs the target's throat, preventing them from using sound moves for 2 turns afterwards.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.text: A deafeningly loud, wicked lightning bolt is summoned. This has a 30% chance to paralyze the foe. This can't miss in the Rain.

moves.name: Thunder Cage
moves.text: The user traps the foe in an electrified cage, preventing switching out and dealing 12% damage per turn for 3-5 turns.

moves.name: Thunder Fang
moves.text: The user bites the foe with electrified fangs. This has a 25% flinch rate, and a 10% chance to paralyze the foe. Contact.

moves.name: Thunder Punch
moves.text: The target is punched with an electrified fist. This has a 10% chance to paralyze the foe. Contact.

moves.name: Thunder Shock
moves.text: A jolt of electricity crashes down on the target. This ALWAYS leaves the target paralyzed.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.text: The user launches a weak wave of electricity that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.text: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This leaves the target paralyzed 10% of the time.

moves.name: Thunderclap
moves.text: The user unleashes a quick, loud shockwave. This ALWAYS crits, fails if the target isn't using a damaging move. +2 priority.

moves.name: Thunderous Kick
moves.text: The user kicks with shocking power and vigor. This deals 33% recoil to the user, but ALWAYS paralyzes.

moves.name: Tickle
moves.text: The user tickles the target, lowering it's Attack and Defense by 1.

moves.name: Tidy Up
moves.text: The user cleans up the area around it, removing any hazards or substitutes. This also boosts Atk/Speed by 1. -1 Priority.

moves.name: Time Out
moves.text: The user calls a time out. This heals the user and any allies to FULL HP. +4 Priority.

moves.name: Topsy-Turvy
moves.text: Using mental manipulation, the user reverses any stat changes the foe has. This has +4 Priority.

moves.name: Torch Song
moves.text: Skeledirge blows out raging flames while singing a song. This ALWAYS boosts Sp. Atk by 1.

moves.name: Torment
moves.text: The user torments and enrages the foe, making them incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

moves.name: Torrential Pulse
moves.text: The user unleashes a potent, intense pulse of water at the foe. This ALWAYS crits, but can't be used 2x in a row.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.text: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Toxic Spikes
moves.text: The user lays toxic spikes around the foe's side, poisoning foes who switch in, with 2 layers badly poisoning.

moves.name: Toxic Thread
moves.text: The user wraps the foe in poisonous silk. This Poisons the foes while dropping Attack, Sp. Atk and Speed by 2.

moves.name: Trailblaze
moves.text: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. This boosts the user's Speed by 1 after use. Contact.

moves.name: Transform
moves.text: The user transforms into a copy of the foe, besides the HP stat. This has +6 Priority.

moves.name: Tri Attack
moves.text: The user shoots three volatile beams. This hits 3 times, with each hit having a 10% chance to either burn, paralyze or freeze.

moves.name: Trick
moves.text: The user swaps the target's held item with their own. +4 Priority.

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.text: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokemon move first for 5 turns. This has only -1 priority.

moves.name: Triple Arrows
moves.text: Decidueye kicks then shoots 3 arrows. Has +3 priority, ALWAYS crits and drops Defense. However, it can't be used 2x in a row.

moves.name: Triple Axel
moves.text: This skillful 3 strike attack increases by 20 BP for each hit. Contact. 1 hit: 4.75% (20 BP), 2 hits: 4.5125% (60 BP), 3 hits: 85.7375% (120 BP)

moves.name: Triple Dive
moves.text: Wugtrio's 3 bodies dive forward all at once. This has a 30% flinch rate, 50% crit rate, and ALWAYS drops Defense. Contact.

moves.name: Triple Kick
moves.text: This kick ALWAYS lands a critical hit and can't miss anymore. This makes it effectively 90 BP overall (15, 30 and 45 per hit.) Contact.

moves.name: Trop Kick
moves.text: The user lands an intense jungle kick on the foe. This ALWAYS drops BOTH of the foe's offensive stats by 1. Contact.

moves.name: Twilight Cannon
moves.text: The user fires a devastating beam fueled by energy from the moon. This lowers the users Sp. Atk by 2 after use, however.

moves.name: Twister
moves.text: The user creates a weak spiral of wind with dragon energy. This has +1 Priority, and can't miss.

moves.name: U-Turn
moves.text: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a different Pokemon. This attack cannot miss. Contact.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.text: The user creates a loud, unyielding ruckus for 3 turns. During these turns, no Pokemon can fall asleep.

moves.name: Vacuum Wave
moves.text: The user creates a wave of pure vacuum and sends it at the foe. This has +1 priority, and can't miss. Contact.

moves.name: Venoshock
moves.text: The user drenches the target in a special liquid. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

moves.name: Victory Dance
moves.text: The user riles itself up with a vigorous dance. This boosts Atk, Defense and Speed by 1. -1 Priority.

moves.name: Vine Lashes
moves.text: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines. This hits two times, with each hit lowering Defense by 1 after use. Contact.

moves.name: Vise Grip
moves.text: The target is gripped from both sides for 3-5 turns, preventing switching & dealing 12% of the foe's max HP per turn. Contact.

moves.name: Volt Switch
moves.text: Firing off a quick jolt of electricity, the user rushes back to switch places with an ally. This can't miss.

moves.name: Volt Tackle
moves.text: The user charges the foe aggressively while electrified.This deals 33% recoil, and has a 25% chance to paralyze the foe. Contact.

moves.name: Wallop
moves.text: The user strikes the target playfully. This hits 2-5 times in a row. Contact.

moves.name: Water Gun
moves.text: The user shoots a concentrated but weak shot of water at the foe. This has now +1 priority, and can't miss.

moves.name: Water Pledge
moves.text: A column of water damages the foe. This has a 25% chance to boost Sp. Atk by 1. This can be combined with another pledge.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.text: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. ALWAYS confuses the target for 5 turns. (Or until switched)

moves.name: Water Shuriken
moves.text: Greninja throws shurikens made from water with immense skill. This hits THREE times with a 50% crit rate. (100% with Super Luck)

moves.name: Water Spout
moves.text: The user attacks the foes with a massive spout of water. The lower the user's HP, the lower this move's power. If full HP, 150 BP.

moves.name: Wave Crash
moves.text: The user surges towards the foe with great force. This deals 33% recoil to the user, and has a 20% flinch rate. Contact.

moves.name: Weather Ball
moves.text: The user fires off a ball of energy that changes type & doubles in power based on the weather. This drops Sp. Def 50% of the time.

moves.name: Whiplash
moves.text: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, or the like. This always drops the foe's Defense by 1. Contact.

moves.name: Whirlpool
moves.text: The user envelops the target in a whirlpool, trapping them in battle for 3-5 turns & dealing 12% of their HP per turn.

moves.name: Whirlwind
moves.text: The user rapidly whips up a turbulent whirlwind that forces the target out of battle. This has +4 Priority.

moves.name: Wicked Blow
moves.text: The user strikes the target with a wicked blow. ALWAYS results in a critical hit, and can't be used 2x in a row. Contact.

moves.name: Wild Charge
moves.text: Charged with electricity, the user smashes into the target. This deals 20% recoil, and has a 20% chance to paralyze. Contact.

moves.name: Wildbolt Storm
moves.text: The user whips up a thunderstorm and sends it at the foe. This ALWAYS flinches and paralyzes. +4 Priority.

moves.name: Wildfire
moves.text: The user summons a wild, intense blast of fire to torment the foe. This ALWAYS crits, and can't be used 2x in a row.

moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.text: The user burns the target with an eerie flame.

moves.name: Wing Attack
moves.text: The user swipes hard at the foe using one of its wings. 30% flinch rate. Contact.

moves.name: Wish
moves.text: One turn after Wish is used, the user or it's replacement's HP is restored by 50% of the user's HP.

moves.name: Withdraw
moves.text: The user withdraws into it's hard shell, raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats by 1.

moves.name: Wonder Room
moves.text: For 5 turns, the Sp. Def & Defense stats are swapped for all Pokemon on the field. ALWAYS goes first.

moves.name: Wood Hammer
moves.text: The user powerfully slams its rugged body into the foe. Deals 33% recoil to the user, and drops Defense 30% of the time. Contact.

moves.name: Work Up
moves.text: The user rouses itself, boosting its Attack and Sp. Atk stats by 1.

moves.name: Worry Seed
moves.text: A seed that causes anxiety is planted on the foe, turning the foe's ability into Insomnia.

moves.name: Wrap
moves.text: The target is squeezed for 3-5 turns, preventing switching & dealing 12% of the foe's max HP per turn. Contact.

moves.name: X-Scissor
moves.text: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes, claws or the like. This has a 50% (+2) crit rate. Contact.

moves.name: Yawn
moves.text: The user yawns, making the foe drowsy. The foe will fall asleep at the end of the next turn.

moves.name: Zap Cannon
moves.text: The user fires a wicked blast of electricity at the target. This drops the user's Sp. Atk stat by 2 after use.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.text: The user focuses its willpower to it's head and charges the foe. This flinches 30% of the time. Contact.

moves.name: Zing Zap
moves.text: The user swiftly strikes the foe, shocking it. This has a 30% flinch rate, and ALWAYS boosts the user's Speed by 1 after use. Contact.
